'''Black_wraith HeboB''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Black_wraith]]
* '''Published:''' 16 March 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 HB Black wraith LS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Rebel Planners (V), General Carlist Rieekan (V), Commander Luke Skywalker (V), Flash Of Insight (V), Dual Laser Cannon (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

HB + EBO = HeboB

The published list has 69 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 69 as published: the nine '>' system lines under AUAOF (Hoth x2, Kiffex x2, Coruscant (se), Endor x2, Kessel x2) are not in any header count; the headers add to 60.
* Coruscant appears twice: '>Coruscant (se)' (Special Edition) and the base marker 'Coruscant (cor)' (Coruscant set); both are the card titled Coruscant.
* Battle Plan (Effects section) dested as the Endor Effect, not the Reflections III shield; EBO dested Echo Base Operations (Effect).
* Original-era (V): Commander Luke Skywalker (V), General Carlist Rieekan (V), Dual Laser Cannon (V) (Virtual Set 4); Flash Of Insight (V) (Virtual Set 5); Rebel Planners (V) (Virtual Set 6).
* Posted Rouge dested Rogue; Echo War room dested Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room); Hoth MPG dested Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker); Bata Tank dested Bacta Tank.

== Strategy ==

Now I know a lot of people are going to laugh at this deck at first because “I’m doing too much.” Well I’ve got the time to do too much. But that’s not the reason you should laugh at this deck. The reason you should laugh is that when I was constructing this deck, I got nearly finished, then remembered I didn’t have a rendezvous point. But anyway while you’re laughing, below is how it would be play as it’s listed above….

Turn 1

Pull Rieekan, McQuarrie, Luke, Hobbie And/or Bacta tank. Hopefully you’ve got a hoth site in hand, deploy it with Rieekan there, and use him to pull the shields (unless the shield was in your hand, other wise use him to either pull another site or a speeder). Play a system, play any X-Wings to rendezvous point. If Rieekan is in the cold, move him indoors (or at least under the shields) or draw one.

Turn 2

Use Rieekan to pull a site, Hoth sentry, or a speeder (pull a site unless you’ve got them already) use Echo garrison to pull Hobbie, Luke or Bacta tack. Deploy McQuarrie and/or Luke/Hobbie with Speeder. Deploy system. Deploy any other cards possible (x-wings to rp, effects to table ect.).  Move Rieekan further indoors and/or draw any unused force

Turn 3

Use Rieekan to pull any other sites, Speeders, sentry, or ebo and echo base garrison to pull any applicable cards. Deploy system and any other cards.

Turn 4-5

Use Rieekan and EBG to pull any thing useful. By this time you should have Rieekan at the war room, McQuarrie at the corridor, Hobbie at the DB and Luke at the 4th. Deploy ebo and systems until you get the flip, spread out x wings and drain like a sieve.

As I said above this is more of a theoretical deck, since I don’t have a rendezvous point yet, so as for match ups, you tell me.
